Magnetic shear conjugations, actual coupled interfaces and an endpoint/tracking distinction

1. EXACT PHYSICAL MAGNETIC REPRESENTATION.
Use the unit three-torus, kappa=2pi, i!=j, F(x)=e_i s(x_j), with s=sin(kappa x_j) or cos(kappa x_j). Let
 Phi_a(x)=x+a s(x_j)e_i,
 T_a q(x)=q(x-a s(x_j)e_i),
 c=s', E=e_i tensor e_j.
The ideal induction equation B_t+(w.grad)B-(B.grad)w=0 under w=b(t)F has exact propagator
 M_a=(I+a c E)T_a, a=integral b(t)dt.
It is the volume-preserving pushforward by Phi_a, not the physical linearized Euler propagator. T_a and multiplication by c commute, E^2=0, and M_a^-1=M_-a. The Piola identity preserves divergence. For a solenoidal B, integral c B_j=-integral s partial_j B_j=0 by periodic integration in the other coordinates, so the mean is also preserved.

The explicit shear map, inverse Jacobian and finite chain rule give, for each FIXED nonnegative integer m,
 ||M_a^+/-1||_(H^m->H^m)<=C_m(1+|a|)^(m+1).
The constants include the fixed powers of kappa and are effectively bounded. This holds on all fields for the norm estimate and on the solenoidal mean-zero space for the physical interpretation. It is polynomial for long impulses. No stability of a generic magnetic velocity field is inferred.

## Conclusion

**Yes, using the quantitative Navier–Stokes constructions stipulated in the question.** The additional MHD construction is a common joint eraser: it makes both fields small in \(H^1\), using mechanical forcing alone, with polynomial resources. The supplied velocity-target construction then extends to MHD without a frequency-dependent increase in synthesis depth.

The essential new operation is to alternate:

1. a short, large-displacement fundamental-shear excursion that contributes to enhanced magnetic diffusion; and
2. a common velocity erasure followed by a short unforced smoothing interval.

The second operation controls the velocity generated by the Lorentz force. Magnetic diffusion remains active throughout both operations. A quantitative averaging argument gives contraction of the resulting magnetic evolution in operator norm; a single global Duhamel estimate then controls its nonlinear induction term.

I give the construction below, including a finite procedure defining the constants \(A,p\). The resulting exponent is enormous. Its value is independent of the target’s support, coefficients and encoding.

All uses of the earlier Navier–Stokes machinery below refer to the accepted quantitative constructions in your question and preceding premises. The bounded-domain result of Liao–Sueur–Zhang has a different scope: it is non-resistive, uses boundary control of both fields, and assumes much smoother data. It is not an MHD control theorem being imported into this argument. [arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/html/2505.07366v1?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
